assets.name: bank
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized 3D game asset concept and image-to-3D reference. Create ONE complete isolated Starhaven settlement asset in a three-quarter front view, entire roof-to-foundation footprint visible with generous margin, plain light gray seamless studio background, soft neutral studio illumination with modest emissive accent. Rich hand-painted concept art appearance with crisp construction geometry and intricate layered painted surface textures. Starhaven is an arcane frontier gothic settlement in deep T70 wilderness: black-violet nightglass masonry veined subtly with silver, dark starwood timber, oxidized silver metal bands, deep indigo roof tiles, restrained cyan and mauve lamp glow, small carved constellation motifs. Medieval joinery and weight-bearing structure; believable occupied and usable architecture. Distinct from warm teak and charcoal lower-tier towns. Avoid sci-fi, sterile monochrome, cartoon toy proportions, excessive crystals, levitating pieces, scene terrain or diorama base, people, signage text, labels, watermark. Keep all sides and corners uncut; door and functional frontage visible.
Specific asset: A compact but formidable town bank: broad two-story rectangular stone counting house, deep indigo hipped roof, recessed heavy silver-strapped double entry doors, two barred transaction windows at street level, a small projecting secure vault wing, fine constellation carving above the lintel, aged silver trim and varied stone blocks. Wealth and security conveyed through craft and mass, not a fantasy palace.
